hero.title: Lifetime pack for Robrun
hero.lead: Pay once, keep access. Your license key appears on screen and in your inbox right after payment clears.
products.title: Products
products.sub: One pack on sale right now. Fixed price, no hidden fees.
steps.title: How it works
steps.1d: See the price, one click to checkout.
steps.2d: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PayPal.
steps.3d: Key shows on screen and lands in your inbox.
features.title: Why this pack?
features.sub: No flashy promises. Three simple things.
f.1d: No subscription, no renewals, no hidden fees.
f.2d: Keys are generated automatically. No waiting on anyone.
faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Can't find it? Just ask us.
faq.q1: How do I get my key?
faq.a1: The moment payment clears, your key appears on screen and is emailed to you. If you lose it, open "Find my key" and use your email plus order number.
faq.a2: Payments run through Gumroad: credit/debit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal. Your card details never reach us.
faq.a3: Within 7 days of purchase, as long as the key has not been used. Details are in the refund policy.
final.title: Ready when you are
final.lead: One payment, instant delivery. Good time to decide.
p.delivery.title: Delivery
p.delivery.text: Once payment clears, your license key appears on this page and is emailed to you. Keep it in the inbox you paid with.
ty.title: Get your key
ty.lead: Use the order number from your Gumroad receipt and the email you paid with.
ty.hint: The order number is in the email from Gumroad.
ty.notfound: No order found with those details.
